_about: Objective system-design items: trade-offs, scaling, data, messaging, reliability and back-of-envelope estimation (computations executed by verify.mjs).

mcq.q: According to the CAP theorem, during a network partition a distributed system must choose between:
mcq.answer: Consistency and availability

mcq.q: What is the main benefit of consistent hashing?
options: Only a small fraction of keys move when nodes are added or removed
It removes the need for replication
mcq.answer: Only a small fraction of keys move when nodes are added or removed

mcq.q: Which caching policy writes to the cache and the database synchronously on every write?
mcq.answer: Write-through

mcq.q: A popular cache key expires and thousands of requests hit the database at once. What mitigates this?
options: Request coalescing or a lock so a single request recomputes the value
mcq.answer: Request coalescing or a lock so a single request recomputes the value

mcq.q: Which store is a typical fit for very high write volumes of time-ordered events (e.g., IoT readings)?
options: A wide-column or time-series database such as Cassandra
A single relational table without indexes
mcq.answer: A wide-column or time-series database such as Cassandra

mcq.q: What consistency problem do asynchronous read replicas introduce?
options: Replication lag can serve stale reads
mcq.answer: Replication lag can serve stale reads

mcq.q: Why must consumers be idempotent under at-least-once delivery?
options: The same message may be delivered more than once
Messages are always delivered out of order
mcq.answer: The same message may be delivered more than once

mcq.q: What is a dead-letter queue used for?
options: Holding messages that repeatedly fail processing so they can be inspected
mcq.answer: Holding messages that repeatedly fail processing so they can be inspected

mcq.q: Which component spreads traffic across instances and stops routing to unhealthy ones?
options: A load balancer with health checks
mcq.answer: A load balancer with health checks

mcq.q: Roughly how many distinct 7-character short codes can a base62 URL shortener generate?
mcq.answer: About 3.5 trillion

mcq.q: What is the technique of splitting one large table's rows across multiple machines by a key?
mcq.answer: Sharding (horizontal partitioning)

mcq.q: What does a CDN primarily reduce?
options: Latency, by serving content from edge locations near users
mcq.answer: Latency, by serving content from edge locations near users

mcq.q: Which rate-limiting algorithm allows short bursts up to a capacity while refilling at a steady rate?
mcq.answer: Token bucket

mcq.q: A service receives 100 million requests per day. What is the approximate average request rate?
mcq.answer: About 1,200 requests per second

verify.src:
r = 100_000_000 / 86_400
print('About 1,200 requests per second' if 1100 < r < 1300 else r)

mcq.q: What is the main benefit of an event-driven architecture built on a message broker?
options: Services are decoupled and can scale and fail independently
mcq.answer: Services are decoupled and can scale and fail independently

mcq.q: In leader–follower replication, where do writes go?
options: To the leader, which propagates changes to followers
To every follower directly by the client
mcq.answer: To the leader, which propagates changes to followers

mcq.q: With N = 3 replicas, when do quorum reads and writes guarantee that a read sees the latest write?
options: When R + W > N, e.g. R = 2 and W = 2
mcq.answer: When R + W > N, e.g. R = 2 and W = 2

mcq.q: What is the Saga pattern used for?
options: Coordinating a distributed transaction as local transactions with compensating actions
mcq.answer: Coordinating a distributed transaction as local transactions with compensating actions

mcq.q: What does a circuit breaker prevent?
options: Cascading failures, by failing fast while a dependency is unhealthy
mcq.answer: Cascading failures, by failing fast while a dependency is unhealthy

mcq.q: Where should large, immutable media files (videos, images) usually be stored?
options: Object storage such as S3, served through a CDN
mcq.answer: Object storage such as S3, served through a CDN

mcq.q: What does a p99 latency of 300 ms mean?
options: 99% of requests complete in 300 ms or less
mcq.answer: 99% of requests complete in 300 ms or less

mcq.q: Why put a queue between order placement and sending the confirmation email?
options: So email is sent asynchronously and order placement stays fast and reliable
To remove the need for a database
mcq.answer: So email is sent asynchronously and order placement stays fast and reliable

mcq.q: What is geohashing used for?
options: Indexing locations so that nearby points share key prefixes
mcq.answer: Indexing locations so that nearby points share key prefixes

mcq.q: Which technology best suits pushing new chat messages from server to client in real time?
mcq.answer: WebSockets

mcq.q: What makes horizontally scaling web servers that hold user sessions easier?
options: Moving session state to a shared store such as Redis
Pinning every user to one server forever
mcq.answer: Moving session state to a shared store such as Redis

mcq.q: What does 'eventual consistency' guarantee?
options: If no new updates occur, all replicas eventually converge to the same value
Every read returns the latest write
mcq.answer: If no new updates occur, all replicas eventually converge to the same value

mcq.q: What can a Bloom filter tell you about an item?
options: It is definitely not in the set, or it is possibly in the set
Its exact position in the set
How many times it was inserted
That it is definitely in the set
mcq.answer: It is definitely not in the set, or it is possibly in the set

mcq.q: How do autocomplete services usually serve suggestions within a few milliseconds?
options: From a prefix index (e.g., a trie) with precomputed top-k results per prefix, heavily cached
By running a full-text database scan for every keystroke
By sorting the whole query log per request
mcq.answer: From a prefix index (e.g., a trie) with precomputed top-k results per prefix, heavily cached

mcq.q: What does adding jitter to exponential backoff prevent?
options: Many clients retrying in synchronised waves
mcq.answer: Many clients retrying in synchronised waves

mcq.q: A request must pass through two independent services in series, each 99.9% available. What is the combined availability?
mcq.answer: About 99.8%

verify.src:
a = 0.999 ** 2
print('About 99.8%' if abs(a - 0.998) < 0.0005 else a)

written.q: Design a global URL-shortening service expected to create 100 million links per day and serve redirects with a 99th-percentile latency below 50 ms. Cover the create and redirect APIs, short-code generation and collision handling, read/write data models, partitioning and replication, hot-link caching, custom aliases, expiration, abuse prevention, and analytics. Trace a redirect request end to end, estimate the storage and traffic order of magnitude, and explain how the design behaves when the cache or an analytics consumer is unavailable.

Design a multi-region chat platform for 10 million daily active users with one-to-one and group conversations, delivery to multiple devices, offline history, and a 99.99% availability target. Explain connection management, message APIs, durable storage and ordering, fan-out for large groups, unread state, push notifications, reconnect and replay, and the consistency guarantees users see. Include partition keys, back-pressure, privacy controls, and what happens during a region or message-broker outage.

Design a food-delivery platform serving several cities, with restaurant search, order placement, payment, courier assignment, live location, and customer tracking. An order must not be charged twice, courier locations update every few seconds, and restaurants and couriers may go offline. Describe the services and data ownership, APIs and event flow, geospatial indexing, matching and dispatch, payment/order consistency, status updates, and client notifications. State peak-load assumptions and explain how you handle delayed events, cancellation, and a dependency outage.

Design an autocomplete service for a search product receiving 50,000 keystroke queries per second across multiple regions. Suggestions must return in under 30 ms, reflect popularity changes within minutes, and support prefix matching, ranking, typo tolerance, and regional language settings. Describe the online query path and offline ingestion pipeline, the index and ranking model, sharding and cache strategy, freshness and consistency, privacy and abuse limits, and a fallback when the index or analytics pipeline is degraded. Include a capacity assumption and the key metrics you would alert on.

Design a rate-limiting service used by API gateways in three regions to enforce per-user and per-tenant quotas, burst allowances, and endpoint-specific limits. The decision should add less than 5 ms at the 99th percentile, support configuration changes within seconds, and remain predictable during a regional network partition. Compare token bucket with at least one alternative; explain key design, atomic updates, storage and partitioning, local caching, fail-open versus fail-closed policy, fairness, observability, and how you would test clock skew and concurrent requests.

Design a video-upload and playback platform for user-generated videos. Uploads may be several gigabytes and resumable; a video should become playable in multiple resolutions, be protected by access controls, and stream globally with low startup delay. Describe upload APIs and chunk state, durable object storage, asynchronous transcoding and job retries, metadata and search, CDN/origin behavior, publication state, quotas and abuse scanning, and deletion/retention. Estimate the major storage and bandwidth costs and explain how you prevent a failed transcode from losing the original upload.
